source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Document the date, time, and location of the vehicle inspection.
3. Include the vehicle identification number (VIN), make, model, and year.
4. List all the inspection items.
5. Describe the failure.
6. Include any diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) associated with the brake system.
7. Indicate whether the vehicle is safe to drive.
8. Obtain signatures.

## Start with the inspection records.

Determine that there is an existing record where to document the test results.

## Document the date, time, and location of the vehicle inspection.

When and where the inspection occurred. This information can be crucial for identifying any contributing factors to the brake failure.

## Include the vehicle identification number (VIN), make, model, and year.

This information will ensure that the report is clear and accurate.

## List all the inspection items.

Listing all inspection items creates a complete record
